name: Crop rotation
description: Alternating botanically unrelated crops across seasons so that host-specific soilborne pathogens and weeds lose their host between cycles.

name: No-till direct seeding
description: Seeding directly into undisturbed residue-covered soil, conserving stored moisture and reducing wind and water erosion.

name: Deep tillage
description: Subsoiling below the compacted layer to break plough pans and restore downward water movement in heavy soils.

name: Deficit irrigation
description: Deliberately applying less water than full crop demand, concentrating the available supply on the growth stages where yield response is steepest.

name: Drip irrigation
description: Delivering water directly to the root zone through emitters, cutting evaporative loss and keeping the canopy dry.

name: Cover cropping
description: Growing a non-harvested crop between cash crops to protect the soil surface, add organic matter and suppress weeds.

name: IPM scouting and thresholds
description: Systematic field monitoring so that an intervention is triggered only when pest density crosses an economic threshold.

name: Pheromone mass trapping
description: Deploying pheromone-baited traps at density high enough to suppress the adult population and delay chemical intervention.

name: Resistant cultivar selection
description: Choosing cultivars carrying genetic resistance to the dominant local pathogen races.

name: Soil solarization
description: Covering moist soil with transparent plastic during peak summer so that accumulated heat kills soilborne pathogens and nematode juveniles.

name: Split nitrogen application
description: Dividing the nitrogen dose across several growth stages to match uptake demand and reduce leaching and volatilisation losses.

name: Gypsum amendment
description: Applying calcium sulfate to displace exchangeable sodium in sodic soils, restoring aggregate structure and infiltration.
